result.instructions: Tools for Sorted, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our shipments were delivered yesterday, and which are still in transit?"; "Show me every tracking event for shipment sp_… in order."; "Register these three new shipments with their order numbers as custom references.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Sorted data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sorted_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sorted_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sorted_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. sorted_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sorted_get_shipment
tools.title: Get a shipment
tools.description: Get one registered shipment by its Track id: state, carrier, dates, addresses, references and metadata. Track API: GET /shipments/{id}.

shipment_id.description: Track shipment id, for example sp_… (from sorted_search_shipments).

tools.name: sorted_search_shipments
tools.title: Search shipments
tools.description: List shipments, optionally in a date window (start and end together, max 14 days), or filter by tracking or custom reference or by metadata. Use page for more results. Track API: GET /shipments/search.

start.description: Range start, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z). Optional; send with end.

end.description: Range end, ISO 8601. Optional; send with start. The range may not exceed 14 days.

tracking_references.description: Tracking references. A shipment must contain all of them to match.

custom_references.description: Your own custom references. A shipment must contain all of them to match.

tools.name: sorted_get_event
tools.title: Get an event
tools.description: Get one tracking event by its Track event id. Track API: GET /events/{id}.

tools.name: sorted_search_events
tools.title: Search events
tools.description: List tracking events, optionally in a date window (start and end together, max 14 days), filtered by tracking or custom reference or carrier. Track API: GET /events/search.

start.description: Range start, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z). Optional; send with end.

end.description: Range end, ISO 8601. Optional; send with start. The range may not exceed 14 days.

tracking_references.description: Tracking references. A shipment must contain all of them to match.

custom_references.description: Your own custom references. A shipment must contain all of them to match.

tools.name: sorted_get_shipment_events
tools.title: Get events for a shipment
tools.description: Get all tracking events recorded for one shipment, by shipment id. Track API: GET /events/search?shipment_id=.

shipment_id.description: Track shipment id, for example sp_… (from sorted_search_shipments).

tools.name: sorted_get_shipment_states
tools.title: Get shipment state history
tools.description: Get the state history of one shipment (each state and when it was set), by shipment id. Track API: GET /events/shipment-states?shipment_id=.

shipment_id.description: Track shipment id, for example sp_… (from sorted_search_shipments).

tools.name: sorted_get_tracking_events
tools.title: Get carrier tracking events
tools.description: Get the raw carrier tracking events for one shipment, by shipment id. Track API: GET /tracking/search?shipment_id=.

shipment_id.description: Track shipment id, for example sp_… (from sorted_search_shipments).

tools.name: sorted_register_shipments
tools.title: Register shipments
tools.description: Register one or more shipments in the customer's Track account so Track starts tracking them. Each shipment needs at least one tracking reference. Registering the same shipment twice creates a duplicate, so check first with sorted_search_shipments. Track API: POST /shipments.

tracking_references.description: Carrier tracking numbers. The first is the primary reference.

unique_references.description: References that identify the shipment for duplicate detection (3 to 50 characters each).

custom_references.description: Your own order or customer references.

country_iso_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, for example GB.

type.description: Value type, for example string, boolean, integer, decimal or date_time.

shipments.description: Shipments to register, 1 to 100 per call. Split larger lists into several calls.

tools.name: sorted_update_shipment
tools.title: Update a shipment
tools.description: Update one registered shipment. Send the full shipment record with the registration fields; the update uses the same fields as registration. Track API: PUT /shipments/{id}.

shipment_id.description: Track shipment id, for example sp_… (from sorted_search_shipments).

tracking_references.description: Carrier tracking numbers. The first is the primary reference.

unique_references.description: References that identify the shipment for duplicate detection (3 to 50 characters each).

custom_references.description: Your own order or customer references.

country_iso_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, for example GB.

type.description: Value type, for example string, boolean, integer, decimal or date_time.
